detailed_slide_analysis.notes: Perfect V7 compliance. Hero layout with glowing teal accent, left-aligned text, DATA BACKBONE eyebrow badge, massive headline with teal highlight.

Excellent data presentation but uses orange/amber (#FF7A00) as secondary accent alongside teal. V7 allows orange as secondary highlight. Source citations present but small. Layout is data dashboard/card-based not flowchart.
Perfect split layout. Technical accuracy verified: Kafka commit log vs message queue explanation is 100% correct. Uses orange for 'vs Message Queue' text which is allowed as secondary accent.
Excellent outro with numbered summary (01, 02, 03) and specific CTA 'Save this explainer. It's your Kafka cheat sheet.' Matches CONTENT_ENGINEERING.md requirements perfectly.
Perfect hero layout. 'RUST VS GO' with GO in orange. SYSTEMS ARCHITECTURE 101 eyebrow. Clear cloud velocity vs absolute control framing.

Good split layout. Data accuracy: 73% Go in CNCF plausible (CNCF 2022 said 87% for new apps). '#1 Most Loved Language 8 years' for Rust is accurate. Source citation issue: 'GitHub Octoverse 25' is future-dated (typo).
Near-perfect V7 compliance. Hero layout with SQL INTERVIEW 101 eyebrow. Massive 'DELETE VS TRUNCATE VS DROP' headline with DROP in italics. Clear value prop in subtitle.

Perfect aspect ratio (4:5) and background color (#0F0F13) adherence
Strong visual hierarchy with proper eyebrow badges, headlines, body text
Correct use of Inter font with proper type scale (1.5 ratio)

Hero and Outro layouts follow CONTENT_ENGINEERING.md rules perfectly
Numbered summaries and specific CTAs on final slides

Proper use of teal (#00E5CC) as primary accent

Source citations sometimes too small for mobile readability
One instance of future-dated citation 'GitHub Octoverse 25' (typo)
Some slides have incomplete sentences (may be intentional for carousel flow)

Footer text (handle + slide number) can be small on mobile
key_findings.v7_compliance_summary: All carousels show strong to excellent V7 compliance. The system is producing high-quality, design-system-compliant output. The engine correctly implements the 2-color rule (teal + orange), Inter font, 4:5 aspect ratio, and diverse layout types. Content engineering rules (5-7 slides, aggressive compression, zero fluff, hook/close) are being followed.
